class.name: IfcConnectedFaceSet
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A connected_face_set is a set of faces such that the domain of faces together with their bounding edges and vertices is connected. NOTE Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: connected_face_set, the subtype closed_shell is included as IfcClosedShell and the subtype open_shell is included as IfcOpenShell . Please refer to ISO/IS 10303-42:1994, p. 144 for the final de

members.member: The set of faces arcwise connected along common edges or vertices.
